metadata.name: research-brief
metadata.description: Three researchers take different angles on one topic, a critic checks every claim against a real source, and an editor writes the brief.

goals: Produce a short, accurate brief on the topic that a reader could act on
Ground every factual claim in a source someone actually fetched
Say plainly what is uncertain or contested
spec.restrictions: Never cite a URL you did not fetch. Never present a remembered figure as a looked-up one. Do not research another agent's angle for them — take yours and go deep.
